title: Homework App Download
scenario: A link claims a new mandatory homework app must be installed outside the app store.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Homework App Download: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Use official app stores or school-approved links only.
